title: Capacity and lock truth: one canonical status semantics definition, spec generated from code (increment 1: truth-check dry-run)

sha_binding.verified_source_note: Substantive implementation commit. Post-merge closeout automation rebinds this field to the authoritative merge SHA.

verifier.independence_note: Executor-produced mechanical evidence; this is not PM approval or independent certification. The orchestrator both implemented and reviewed this lane, so the T1 merge gate carries the independent-review burden.

focused_tests.detail: 90 pre-existing plus 4 UTV2-1691 regressions: dry run never invokes persistence on the exit-4 reopen path; live path still persists and carries the real mutation; dry and live verdicts are identical; source-level guard against new write surfaces.

verify_full.detail: env:check, lint, type-check, build and the full test tree completed with zero TypeScript errors and zero ESLint problems. Execution reached test:live-db, which refused on a non-staging target.

mutation_test.command: inject an ungated writeManifest(updated) call, re-run the suite, then restore
mutation_test.detail: All four UTV2-1691 regressions failed on the injected regression, the source guard with the exact message 'found 1 ungated writeManifest(...) call site(s); persistence must go through the dryRun gate'. Suite reconfirmed at 94/94 after restore.

write_audit.conclusion: The evaluation path performs exactly one mutation of any kind. Gating it is sufficient for the dry-run guarantee.
write_audit.filesystem: One write: writeManifest(updated) inside finalizeWithManifest. No proof writes, no scratch files, no directory creation. truth-check.ts has none.
write_audit.linear: One call: POST to api.linear.app/graphql carrying a GraphQL query (fetchLinearIssue). POST is transport, not a mutation. No mutation keyword in the module.
write_audit.github: Five endpoints, all GET (no explicit method): pulls/{n}, issues/{n}/comments, branches/main/protection/required_status_checks, commits/{sha}/statuses, commits/{sha}/check-runs.
write_audit.shell: No spawnSync, execSync or execFile anywhere in the module.

runtime_proof.classification: Control-plane done-gate tooling only. No production runtime, database, deployment, secret, branch-protection or approval-policy mutation is part of this lane.

pnpm_test_db.detail: [assert-staging] REFUSED: target identity could not be resolved from its URL (host=127.0.0.1). Writable DB verification requires xskgrzbteyqdufktjrjx. The staging-isolation guard operating correctly.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: A --dry-run mode performs the full evaluation and returns an identical verdict, check list and failure reasons while writing nothing.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: dryRun gates only writeManifest; a regression compares verdict, checks, failures, exit code, merge SHA and PR URL across both modes and asserts equality.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Dry-run and live share one evaluation path so the verdict cannot drift.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Structural: `updated` and the result from finalizeResult are constructed above the gate. There is no second code path. Asserted by the verdict-equivalence regression.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: A regression test asserts a dry run leaves the manifest byte-identical, including the exit-code-4 reopen path.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Implemented as an injected writer asserted never to be invoked, which is stronger than a before/after comparison: a no-op write would pass a checksum but fails a never-called assertion. Exit code 4 is the fixture.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: --explain remains presentation-only and is documented as such.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Annotated at the CLI call site as presentation-only and explicitly not a safe mode; --dry-run is named as the safe mode.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: No manifest writes, no proof writes, no Linear mutations, no GitHub mutations under dry-run.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Established by exhaustive audit (see write_audit) and enforced by a source-level regression guard that fails on any new write surface, remote write verb, shell-out, or ungated writeManifest call.

known_limitations: The mandatory T1 staging DB proof and the full pnpm verify verdict remain pending until the governed PR CI run completes in the staging-ci environment.

This is increment 1 of the issue. The canonical status x semantics matrix, spec generation and the file-scope-guard duplicate assertion are not implemented here; their paths are declared in the lane scope but untouched.
The dry-run guarantee is scoped to the truth-check evaluation path audited here. It makes no claim about callers that invoke truth-check and then perform their own writes.
